raw.rationale: WAY-213613 is a selective inhibitor of the glutamate transporter SLC1A2 (EAAT2), a target whose dependence in adherent cancer lines is largely uncharacterized and unlikely to produce strong lineage-restricted killing at 2.5 µM; PRISM single-dose data for most compounds show no selective lineage, so probabilities are kept near the low base rate with slight elevation for CNS and lung lineages where SLC1A2/glutamate biology is more relevant.
